result.stdout:
fx 0.7.9 · Your repositories as one workspace: for people, for CI and for agents.
fx ui · the workspace in full screen (in a terminal; Ctrl+Q closes it)

Usage: fx <command> [options]

Workspace
  sync [<module>]                              Generate and update what fx owns here and in everything mounted below, from the _fx configuration.
  doctor [<module>]                            Check, without changing anything, that what fx owns here and below is right.
  repo list                                    The repositories of the manifest: mount point, policy and whether they are mounted.
  repo status                                  The mounted repositories that ask for attention: branch, commits ahead and behind, changes.
  repo mount [<names>...]                      Mount repositories: a parked one comes back now; fx sync clones what is missing.
  repo unmount [<names>...]                    Unmount repositories: they are parked in _fx/~$parking/, never deleted.
  repo pull                                    Fast-forward the mounted repositories that have a clean working tree.
  repo add [<url>] [<path>]                    Add a repository to the manifest, mounted where you say; its name comes from the URL unless --name. Nothing is cloned.
  repo remove [<name>]                         Take a repository out of the manifest; its clone stays.
  repo tag [<name>] [<tags>...]                Add tags to a repository, or remove them (--remove).
  repo set [<name>] [<key>] [<values>...]      Change a key of a repository: url, path, mount, depends-on or inherits.
  repo rename [<name>] [<new-name>]            Rename a repository: its references in this workspace change, and the old name stays in aliases.
  worktree add <branch>                        Create a worktree of a branch in the nearest workspace (or --in), with where you are mounted in it.
  worktree mount <branch> <targets>...         Mount more of the tree in a worktree: repositories (with the workspaces on the way) or paths left out.
  worktree unmount <
[truncated]
